headline: Payment Fees on $500 Deposits & Bundles
description: Estimated fees on a $500 project deposit or product bundle across Stripe, PayPal, Square, Shopify, and creator platforms — with reverse pricing to receive $500.

mainEntity.name: How much should I invoice to receive $500 after Stripe fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using Stripe US 2.9% + $0.30: charge = (500 + 0.30) ÷ (1 − 0.029) ≈ $515.24. Confirm in the Stripe calculator if your account uses a different country or Connect fee.

mainEntity.name: Do Shopify plan rates matter on a $500 order?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Online standard card rates fall as you move Basic → Grow → Advanced → Plus. On $500 the gap between Basic (2.9% + $0.30) and Advanced (2.5% + $0.30) is about $2 before you count subscription cost.

mainEntity.name: Should I pass fees through on deposits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some contracts list a card-processing surcharge; others bake fees into the quote. Either way, reverse-price so the net deposit still covers your kickoff costs. See the passing-fees guide for policy notes — not legal advice.
